map.按面料缩水率修正成衣尺寸，支持裁剪尺寸反算与成品尺寸预测: Correct garment size by fabric shrinkage; supports cut-size back-calculation and finished-size prediction
map.缩水率 = (原尺寸 - 水洗后尺寸) / 原尺寸 × 100%: Shrinkage = (original size − washed size) / original size × 100%
map.已知裁剪尺寸与缩水率，预测水洗后成品尺寸: Given cut size and shrinkage, predict post-wash finished size
map.已知目标成品尺寸与缩水率，反算裁剪尺寸: Given target finished size and shrinkage, back-calculate cut size
map.测裁片洗前洗后尺寸算缩水率: Measure cut piece before/after wash to compute shrinkage
map.按目标成品尺寸反推裁尺寸（放缩水）: Back-derive cut size from target finished size (add shrinkage)
map.不同洗涤条件下缩率对比选预缩工艺: Compare shrinkage under wash conditions to choose pre-shrinking process
map.裁 100 cm、洗后 95 cm → 缩水率 = (100 - 95) / 1: Cut 100 cm, washed 95 cm → shrinkage = (100 − 95) / 100 × 100% = 5%; i.e. 5 cm per meter.
map.要成品 100 cm、缩水率 5% → 裁尺寸 = 100 / (1 - 5%): Want finished 100 cm, shrinkage 5% → cut size = 100 / (1 − 5%) ≈ 105.3 cm; cutting short gives insufficient finished.
map.经向纬向缩率一样吗？: Are warp and weft shrinkage the same?
map.通常经向（长）缩率大于纬向（宽），裁布需分别放缩。: Usually warp (length) shrinkage exceeds weft (width); cut fabric with separate allowances.
map.预缩可大幅降低成衣再缩，但回潮与整理残留仍会有残余缩率，需留余。: Pre-shrinking greatly reduces re-shrinkage, but regain and finishing residue leave residual shrinkage, keep margin.
map.缩水率修正工具，按面料缩水率修正成衣尺寸，支持预测成品尺寸与反算裁剪尺寸双向计算: Shrinkage Correction tool corrects garment size by fabric shrinkage, supports two-way calculation of predicted finished size and back-calculated cut size, with common fabric shrinkage reference.
map.输入面料缩水率与成衣目标尺寸，可正向预测水洗后成品尺寸，也可反算裁剪时的放缩尺寸: Enter fabric shrinkage and garment target size to forward-predict post-wash finished size, or back-calculate cut allowance to offset shrinkage; used in pattern making to correct patterns by shrinkage and ensure garment specs.
